title: IonQ Stock: Buy the Dip?
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; note: captions garble some figures and phrases in places
summary: Parkevtate asks whether IonQ's dip is a buying opportunity after a record third quarter: revenue of $174 million, up 336% year on year, yet the shares are down in 2026 on losses and dilution. Management reported that its 256-qubit manufacturing capacity for 2027 is sold out, the SkyWater acquisition contributed $83.5 million of GAAP revenue in its first quarter, and IonQ reached DARPA's quantum benchmarking initiative stage C, the only trapped-ion company to reach the final stage, worth up to $300 million in government grants. He notes management keeps using milestones to raise equity: a $2 billion October raise at a premium took pro forma cash to $3.7 billion, more than tripling the balance sheet. The cash burn is improving, with the operating cash flow to sales ratio at negative 170% over the trailing 12 months versus negative 375% in 2024, but dilution will continue until revenue can sustain the business. Valuation has compressed sharply: forward price-to-sales is 16.7, about a fifth of the near-90 level of the late-2024 quantum frenzy, when he warned investors not to buy IonQ, Rigetti, D-Wave and others after 1,000% runs. His DCF fair value is about $54, so the stock looks undervalued on both measures, with 5x to 50x upside if management's ambitions land. He reiterates his BUY, first given on 23 September, but stresses it is only for investors with very high risk tolerance: IonQ is one of the riskiest stocks in the market, and quantum computing one of the riskiest industries.

calls.base_case: Milestones keep landing on time and on budget; cash burn improves (operating cash flow/sales improved from -375% in 2024 to -170% TTM).
calls.bull_case: Quantum scales and the stock 5x-50x if management's ambitions land.
calls.bear_case: Continued losses and shareholder dilution; company may never reach self-sustaining revenue.
